When the storm rolls in, our toy vehicles are in trouble! The fire truck gets stuck on a slippery ramp, a delivery scooter and van fall into a deep hole, a crane truck teeters on the edge of a pier, and a pickup truck gets buried in the snow.

With powerful engines and strong chains, they work together to pull, lift, and save everyone. This action-packed stop-motion video is perfect for kids who love tractors, trucks, and exciting rescue missions!

In this video, you will see:
An exciting storm story with toy cars.
Brave Red and Yellow Tractors on a rescue mission.
A Fire Truck, Crane Truck, Pickup Truck, and Scooter being rescued.
Action-packed scenes in the rain, mud, and snow.

A fun and catchy song about our tractor heroes!

Dark clouds gather, thunder rolls, in our little diorama world.

Red fire truck on a rusty ramp, trying to get back to the station camp.
With a crusty crack and a twisted trap, wheels are spinning, there's no turning back!

Alarm bell rings, the garage door flies,
Red and yellow heroes rise!
(Chorus)
Hear the call through the wind and rain,
Two brave tractors, a mighty chain!
Headlights cutting through the dark,
Leaving tire tracks, making their mark!
Tractor heroes, strong and true,
Racing in to rescue you!

Tiny scooter and a van of green, swept away in a watery scene.
Down in the drain, they can't break free, a tiny cry, "Come rescue me!"
Then a crane truck sways on a bridge of wood, dangling high where it shouldn't have stood.
Through the storm, two engines roar, ready now for one storm more!
(Guitar Solo)
(Chorus)
Hear the call through the wind and snow,
Two brave tractors, watch them go!
Headlights cutting through the white,
Shining oh so very bright!
Tractor heroes, strong and true,
Racing in to rescue you!
(Outro)
The clouds all part, the sun shines bright,
All the toys are safe tonight.
Driving home in a victory line,
Everyone is feeling fine!
Side by side, a happy crew,
Our rescue team will see you through!

snippet.title: Trucks in Trouble! Tow Truck's Daring River Rescue | Toy Vehicles for Kids
snippet.description:
Trucks in Trouble! Tow Truck's Daring River Rescue | Toy Vehicles for Kids


"Oh no! A red dump truck, a green cement mixer, and a yellow bulldozer have all fallen into the river! They are stuck and can't get out. Who will come to their rescue?
Watch as the brave blue tow truck arrives to save the day! With its powerful crane, the tow truck carefully pulls each of the construction vehicles out of the water and back onto dry land.

Join us for this exciting adventure full of friendship, teamwork, and amazing toy trucks. Will the blue tow truck be able to rescue all of his friends? Find out now!"

노래 가사 (Song Lyrics):
(02:36-04:31)
On a road so sunny and bright,
Three little trucks are happy sights.
Red and green and yellow too,
Vroom, vroom, vroom the whole day through.
Red dump truck was driving fast,
A happy moment meant to last.
But the road ahead gave way, splash!
He fell in, oh what a day!
"Help me, help me!" was his cry,
As he floated slowly by.
Green mixer bounced upon a stone,
With a little wearying groan.
Yellow dozer slipped and slid,
Right into the place he hid.
Now all three friends were in the stream,
A very scary, watery dream.
But wait, who's coming, strong and true?
It's the brave tow truck, painted blue!
Go, go, go, blue tow truck, go!
Lifting friends up from below.
With your mighty hook and crane,
You will save them once again.
Down goes the hook with a little clink,
Pulls red dumper from the brink.
Then green mixer spinning 'round,
Is placed back safely on the ground.
And yellow dozer from the deep,
While his two friends watch and cheer.
Hooray! He's coming, strong and true,
It's the brave tow truck, painted blue!
Go, go, go, blue tow truck, go!
Lifting friends up from below.
With your mighty hook and crane,
You have saved them once again!
Three little trucks are safe and sound,
On the solid, happy ground.
Following the hero, blue and bright,
Driving off into the light.
Vroom, vroom, vroom, the adventure's done,
Helping friends is always fun!

snippet.title: Construction Crew's Biggest Challenge! 🚧 Clearing the Rainbow Obstacle Course!
snippet.description:
Construction Crew's Biggest Challenge! 🚧 Clearing the Rainbow Obstacle Course!

EMERGENCY AT THE CONSTRUCTION SITE! A giant, colorful mess of surprise balls and blocks has spilled all over the new road! It's a Rainbow Obstacle Course, and no one can get through. It’s time to call in the experts!
First, we unbox the entire team from a massive surprise box. Then, the mission begins!
Can they clear the path and finish the job? Let's see how they do it:

excavator The Excavator Tries First! With its giant scoop, it tries to dig up the mess, but the colorful balls just roll and bounce everywhere! Oh no, this is trickier than it looks!

🏗️ The Crane Gives it a Shot! The crane's powerful hook can lift the heavy blocks, but there are too many! It's going to take forever! This job is too big for one truck.

🚚 The Dump Truck to the RESCUE! Here comes the hero of the day! The dump truck is perfect for this job. We'll watch as it carefully loads ALL the colorful balls and blocks into its big tipper bed and HAULS them away! Hooray!

✅ Mission Accomplished! With the path finally clear, the Cement Mixer and Road Roller arrive to finish the road, making it perfectly smooth and strong.

This is a super fun story about teamwork, problem-solving, and how every vehicle has its own special talent. Join the adventure to see if the construction crew can conquer the Rainbow Obstacle Course!
